description: Official Langfuse documentation for agent and LLM evaluation, datasets, experiments, evaluators, scores, tracing, and prompt management.
rules: Fetch current documentation before implementing any Langfuse feature; do not write SDK or API calls from memory. Read the relevant workflow reference in https://github.com/langfuse/skills/tree/main/skills/langfuse/references when available.

For evaluation tasks, start with content/docs/evaluation: datasets and experiments, evaluation methods, and scores. Distinguish SDK experiment evaluators, Langfuse-hosted evaluators, and externally computed scores; follow the requested execution model.

For observability, use content/docs/observability and content/integrations. Prefer framework integrations, run the instrumented path, and inspect emitted traces against current observability best practices before declaring success.

For prompt management, use content/docs/prompt-management. Preserve behavior during migration, choose chat or text deliberately, verify variables and deployment labels, and link prompt versions to generations when tracing is configured.

Prefer the latest stable SDK/API versions unless the project or user requires otherwise. Verify exact versions and use matching language-specific examples; for self-hosted Langfuse, consult the deployment-specific API reference.

For direct Langfuse data operations, prefer langfuse-cli and discover resources and arguments with api __schema and --help before calling them. Use content/docs/api-and-data-platform for access guidance.

If retrieved context is incomplete, discover pages through https://langfuse.com/llms.txt, fetch the relevant page as Markdown by appending .md, or search https://langfuse.com/api/search-docs?query=<url-encoded-query>.
Use reference documentation for API signatures and cookbooks for implementation examples. Use changelogs to confirm feature availability, not as implementation references.
